issue_context.title: ILLink analyzer doesn't warn for attributes on fields/properties/events
comments:
Tagging subscribers to this area: @dotnet/area-system-reflection See info in [area-owners.md](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/docs/area-owners.md) if you want to be subscribed.
Issue Details
The ILLink analyzer is missing warnings for attribute dataflow when the attribute instances are on fields/properties/events. ```csharp class C { [KeepsPublicMethods (Type = typeof (ClassWithKeptPublicMethods))] // warns in ILLink, but not analyzer! public static bool field; } class ClassWithKeptPublicMethods { [RequiresUnreferencedCode ("--ClassWithKeptPublicMethods--")] public static void KeptMethod () { } } class KeepsPublicMethodsAttribute : Attribute { [DynamicallyAccessedMembers (DynamicallyAccessedMemberTypes.PublicMethods)] public Type Type { get; [Kept] set; } } ``` Attributes placed on methods work as expected.
Author: sbomer
Assignees: -
Labels: `area-System.Reflection`, `untriaged`
Milestone: -

`DynamicallyAccessedMembers` has `AttributeTargets.Property`. Even if it weren't, I think could change the example to put it on the setter explicitly, or use a field instead of a property.

review_comments: Wow - didn't know it's possible to use expressions in attribute parameters... TIL :-)
Only if they can be reduced to a constant during compilation time
For this to work in NativeAOT the `Test` method must be marked as reflectable (otherwise we drop custom attributes if I remember correctly).
